title: My Stepson Forged Dissolution, Then Locked Me Out With A $4,500 Check. So I Voided The Sale.
description: Evelyn used her late husband's $92,000 life insurance to buy into her stepson's funeral home, then he forged a dissolution, sent her a $4,500 cremation check, and locked her out. She proved the forgery using bank records, voided the $780,000 corporate buyout, and now owns Eulogy of Lies Memorials, where every program prints his perjury conviction number. #RevengeStory #ForgeryExposed #FuneralHomeJustice
thumb_text: HE SENT A $4,500 CREMATION CHECK, NOW HE DIGS GRAVES
pinned_comment: If your stepson forged your signature, sent you a $4,500 cremation check, and locked you out of the funeral home you invested in, how would you handle it? Share your story in the comments.
